content_md:
CISA flags active exploits: WSO2 JWT admin bypass and Magento unauthenticated account takeover. 9 detections, 2 IOCs. Full analysis + IOCs: 

via Mastodon https://intel.threadlinqs.com/threat/TL-2026-2640

CVE-2026-5430.evidence: Post reports CISA flagging the WSO2 JWT admin bypass as actively exploited; CISA added CVE-2026-5430 to the KEV catalog on 2026-09-24.

CVE-2026-71362.evidence: Same post flags the Magento/Adobe Commerce unauthenticated account takeover; CISA added CVE-2026-71362 to KEV on 2026-09-24.
